ToneOptions.Label: Strategic Foresight
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a forward-looking, strategic tone emphasizing proactive risk mitigation and future operational resilience.

ToneOptions.Label: Technical Authority
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Convey a tone of deep technical expertise, focusing on the advanced AI and ML capabilities driving the solution.

ToneOptions.Label: Business Impact
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a business-centric tone, highlighting the direct correlation between IT stability and commercial success.

ToneOptions.Label: Data-Driven Precision
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Emphasize a precise, data-informed tone, showcasing the accuracy and reliability of the predictive analytics.

GoalOptions.Label: Minimize Outages
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to significantly reduce the frequency and duration of IT service disruptions. Success is measured by a quantifiable decrease in critical incident tickets and associated downtime, ensuring uninterrupted business operations and user satisfaction.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize Resources
GoalOptions.Text: This goal focuses on improving the efficiency of IT operations by preventing unnecessary firefighting and reactive measures. Success means IT teams can dedicate more time to strategic initiatives rather than incident response, leading to better resource allocation and cost savings.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Reliability
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to elevate the overall stability and predictability of the IT environment. Success is demonstrated by a consistent improvement in service level agreements (SLAs) and a reduction in performance degradation events, fostering trust in IT services.

GoalOptions.Label: Drive Innovation
GoalOptions.Text: This goal aims to create a stable operational foundation that enables faster innovation and adoption of new technologies. Success is achieved when the IT infrastructure's reliability allows development teams to deploy new features and services with confidence and speed.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Viability
Criteria: Demonstrates clear ROI through reduced incident-related costs and improved customer retention.
Quantifies the business impact of prevented incidents in terms of revenue protection and operational continuity.
Aligns with strategic business objectives for growth and market leadership.
Highlights competitive advantage gained through superior IT operational stability.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Efficacy
Criteria: Specifies the accuracy and precision of predictive models in identifying potential incidents.
Details the integration capabilities with existing IT monitoring and management tools.
Outlines the scalability and performance of the event-driven architecture under load.
Provides evidence of root cause analysis and automated remediation effectiveness.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Resilience
Criteria: Measures the reduction in Mean Time To Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time To Resolve (MTTR) for critical incidents.
Assesses the system's ability to maintain service availability during predicted or actual failures.
Evaluates the effectiveness of proactive alerts and automated mitigation workflows.
Confirms compliance with relevant IT governance and security standards.
